headerDisplay: Exposes the Pi's HDMI-CEC TV to HomeKit as a Television accessory (power, input switching, and remote-key navigation of the PiTV menu). Published as an external accessory so it appears as a TV tile, not inside the bridge.

name.title: TV Name
name.description: The name shown on the TV tile in the Home app.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Selectable inputs. Each sends a raw CEC frame when chosen. Defaults to HDMI 1/2 using the standard Active-Source frames.
